race.description: Retravision Gr1 Golden Nugget This Friday 3yo Ms Pace
race.comment: SUGA NZ (2) disappointed backers when a beaten favourite last time out but was very good here prior, drawing wider than this and working but sticking on for a 2.7m third. No excuses from this advantageous draw and is race fit now so is worth another chance. AMERICAN FALCON NZ (8) drops in class off a WA Derby prelude last start. Much better placed and while drawn wide he came from a similar barrier to win at this circuit and distance four back. LADY MERMAID (1) ended last prep with a third from the back row at Central Wheatbelt. Proven fresh and gets the ace draw so is capable of a forward showing. INTHEHEARTOFTEXAS (5) is lightly raced with upside and must be respected after scoring first-up at Pinjarra.
